results.content: Leidos Inc., Reston, Virginia, was awarded a $317,986,855 firm-fixed-price contract (HT003826DE014) to provide essential system reintegration, software licensing, and hosting services for the electronic health record system known as MHS GENESIS. MHS GENESIS is a critical defense business system. This contract was awarded as a sole-source bridge. This sole-source bridge contract will reduce in scope during the 12-month period and will facilitate transition to other service contractors while also establishing direct government relationships to solution providers. This award will be funded by fiscal 2026 operations and maintenance funds. The place of performance is Reston, Virginia. The period of performance is July 29, 2026, to Jan. 28, 2028. The Defense Health Agency, Defense Healthcare [...] efforts for operational availability and endurance supply, allowance change requests, maintenance activities, and forward deployed site stock level increases. The delivery order does not include an option provision. Work will be performed in Andover, Massachusetts (95%); and Chesapeake, Virgina (5%). Work is expected to be completed by December 2034. Fiscal 2026 working capital funds (Navy) in the amount of $15,078,910 will be obligated at the time of award and funds will not expire at the end of the current fiscal year. One source was solicited for this sole-source requirement pursuant to the authority set forth in 10 U.S. Code 3204 (a)(1) and one offer was received.
